title: Building my mall world equivalent in Sims
content: I've only just begun to build, and I'm trying really hard to stick to what I remember from my dreams, first. Some things just aren't going to happen, but that's the trade off for working within the game confines. I'm still on the fence about adding the finished builds to the Gallery, they're probably not going to be as good as some, because I'm on console. So I don't have access to many of the usual cheats or any custom content. But I like the idea of having some references, anyway.
